tested:
openmediavault / proxmox-mg / digium-asterisk (NAS, mail-gateway, PBX
appliances) deliberately REMOVED 2026-09-17 (the project owner, verbatim: "we don't
mention those unknown devices! ... The ISO image installation stuff and
the QEMU scenarios stuff are generic and must apply to any image whether
it's proxmox or openmediavalue. These are unknown and we mustn't care
about them. We care about major network vendors... Everything else is
standard qemu or ISO generic management.") - netplex does not maintain
named device support for generic, non-network server software. Once the
generic "install any OS from an ISO" + golden-image workflow (NPX-1222,
Wave 39) exists, a user can bring any of these themselves with no
bespoke profile needed. See NPX-1167's tracker row for the full account.

settings.description: Zabbix (monitoring - included since several labs use it as a network-monitoring target, not network gear itself). Real image sourced 2026-09-17 from Zabbix's own official appliance download page (cdn.zabbix.com/zabbix/appliances/stable/7.0/7.0.30/zabbix_appliance-7.0.30-qcow2.tar.gz, sha256-verified against Zabbix's own published checksum) - free, no vendor account needed (Community Edition). Live-boot-verified through netplex's real platform (rule #58): reaches the real Rocky Linux 8.10 'appliance login:' prompt with nginx and the Zabbix Agent both started - no profile drift needed, this device already matched the vendor reference template. Wave 38.12/NPX-1167.
